description: HAND-COMPUTED M5-T054 proposal-checks case. A 100 ft x 50 ft rectangular building of 3 identical floors on an 8000 sq ft R5 lot with one lot line 10 ft west of the west wall. All expected values are computed by hand below and NEVER by running the module (no self-proving fixture). Two commensurable checks (lot_coverage, building_height) resolve; two structurally non-commensurable checks (rear_yard_depth, residential_far_floor_area) are COULD_NOT_CHECK (provided_fact_not_commensurate) regardless of any rule that happens to produce a number - matching units are not equivalence.

min_lot_line_setback_ft.formula: west wall at x=1000000 minus lot line at x=999990

commensurability.lot_coverage_ratio: COMMENSURABLE: derived lot coverage ratio IS the quantity max_lot_coverage_ratio governs.
commensurability.building_height: COMMENSURABLE: derived cumulative building height (ft) IS the quantity max_building_height governs.
commensurability.rear_yard_depth: NOT COMMENSURABLE: the minimum wall-to-lot-line setback across all walls is not a rear-yard depth (no rear lot line designated) -> could_not_check (provided_fact_not_commensurate). The synthetic pc-rear-yard-demo rule still computes 5 ft; the module refuses to compare against it.
commensurability.residential_far_floor_area: NOT COMMENSURABLE: the geometric gross floor area is not a residential zoning floor area (no zoning deductions) -> could_not_check (provided_fact_not_commensurate). The synthetic pc-residential-far-demo rule still computes 8000*1.5=12000 sq ft; the module refuses to compare against it.

building_height.why: street_width_class not attested -> the synthetic height rule returns professional_review_required with no allowance

expected_attested.note: lot_rule_facts_attested = {zoning_district: R5, street_width_class: wide}; the height allowance resolves.
